ai-1.prerequisites: Separate an observation from a guess; use whole numbers and explain a simple rule.
ai-1.outcome: Explain the difference between human decisions, written rules and learned models; build and test a classroom sorter.

ai-2.prerequisites: Complete Foundations exit evidence; trace ordered instructions and compare counts.
ai-2.outcome: Trace algorithms, inspect data and compare a transparent recommender with a simple starting method.

ai-3.prerequisites: Explain inputs, rules, evidence and privacy; use approved sources and simple fractions.
ai-3.outcome: Build a study buddy that uses approved sources, checks generated claims and explains uncertainty.

ai-4.prerequisites: Complete the Python bridge or demonstrate equivalent skills; use fractions, coordinates and independently trace a function.
ai-4.outcome: Train and evaluate a plant classifier using separate data, a baseline and documented errors.

ai-5.prerequisites: Complete Machine Learning exit evidence and Python readiness; use signed numbers, linear equations and coordinates.
ai-5.outcome: Trace a small neural network and investigate how representation and training affect its mistakes.

ai-6.prerequisites: Complete Generative AI and Machine Learning; demonstrate Python/JSON readiness and understand role permissions.
ai-6.outcome: Build a grounded service with source checks, role permissions, tests and a safe fallback.

ai-7.prerequisites: Complete Machine Learning and AI Engineering; compare baselines, control variables and keep a reproducible record.
ai-7.outcome: Design a reproducible investigation, compare alternatives and defend conclusions with evidence.

python-bridge.prerequisites: After Level 3; no previous Python required. Take the readiness check before deciding to skip.
python-bridge.outcome: Independently trace, write, debug and test Python using conditions, loops, lists, dictionaries and functions.
